Our shared dream of performing Hajj and Umrah together in Makkah & Madinah 🕋.

How our families brought us together in an arranged marriage that feels destined by Allah.
The way we can build all our future adventures from scratch together.
Your sweet smile when we talk about our upcoming Holud and wedding celebrations.
How cozy late-night conversations feel when we share our goals and thoughts.
The fun we'll have when I teach you gaming and we play team matches together 🎮.
Your genuine kindness, respect, and warm heart.

The way we can be completely honest and build deep trust day by day.

How every step of our wedding week feels like opening a new chapter of a fairy tale.
Because you are my wife, my partner in faith, and my forever adventure companion.

lockedChamber.title: Just For My Oaeshi 🔒
lockedChamber.content:
Dearest Oaeshi (my bby, my wife),

Today is our Mehedi night, and as the henna colors your hands, my heart overflows with gratitude. From our first conversation on June 19 to this moment, I thank Allah for bringing us together.

Ahead of us lie Holud, Cholon, Boubad, and a lifetime of shared dreams—performing Hajj and Umrah, going on spontaneous ghuraghuri trips, and adopting our little kitten.

I promise to hold your hand through every chapter of our forever trail.

With all my love,
Khabbab 💛
